title: Chapter 9: Introduction to IP Routing
summary: How a packet crosses a network: frames change at every hop, ARP finds local MAC addresses, the route table picks the exit interface, and static and dynamic routing keep tables current.

visuals.title: The 36 steps of a ping, one at a time
visuals.description: Step through the whole ping from Host_A to Host_B and back: the active device and layer, the packet and frame fields, and the table lookups. (The IP Routing Process, steps 1 to 36)

visuals.title: All 36 steps on one map
visuals.description: A swimlane of Host_A, Lab_A, and Host_B. Filter by kind of step and see the frame change on every cable crossing. (Steps 1 to 36)

visuals.title: The checklist every device runs
visuals.description: See where a received frame passes, stops, or branches on a router and on a host. (Steps 9 and 10, 17 and 18, 26 to 28, 34 and 35)

visuals.title: A ping across switches and routers
visuals.description: Follow one ping through switches, VLANs, and routers. See MAC addresses and TTL change while the IP addresses stay put, and test how static, RIP, and OSPF routes and link failures change the result. (Chapters 9, 10, and 11 together)

visuals.title: Frame vs packet at each hop
visuals.description: Step a packet across the router and see which addresses change. (Review questions 16, 19, written lab 4)

visuals.title: The ARP chase
visuals.description: See who a host ARPs for and how the ARP caches fill in. (Review questions 5, 6, 8, 18, written lab 1, 2, 3, 5)

visuals.title: Anatomy of a frame
visuals.description: Click each frame field and test the FCS with a real CRC. (Review questions 9, 12)

visuals.title: Reading a routing table
visuals.description: Look up an address and see the matching route and exit interface. (Review questions 2, 4, 7, 14)

visuals.title: When the router has no route
visuals.description: Compare a missing route with a lost packet. (Review questions 11, 13)

visuals.title: Autonomous systems and route selection
visuals.description: See where IGP and EGP run, then compare routes by prefix, AD, and metric. (Review question 20)

visuals.title: Static vs dynamic routing
visuals.description: Add a site and compare manual routes with automatic updates. (Review questions 3, 10, 15, 17)

visuals.title: Written lab practice
visuals.description: Fill in the route table and the five statements with instant feedback. (Written lab)
